name: Cohort-Constrained Vector Match with Geographical Regionality
description: Real-world matchmaking (dating apps, gig-economy driver matching) requires vector personality/skill compatibility joined with strict relational geographic and category boundaries.
prompt:
Real-world matchmaking (dating apps, gig-economy driver matching) requires vector personality/skill compatibility joined with strict relational geographic and category boundaries.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: job_id, region, candidate_id, skill_fit_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Match jobs to candidates strictly within matching geographical region ordered by skill compatibility
            SELECT 
                j.job_id,
                j.region,
                c.candidate_id,
                ROUND(array_cosine_similarity(c.skills_vec, j.required_vec), 4) AS skill_fit_score
            FROM job_openings j
            JOIN candidates c
              ON j.region = c.region
            ORDER BY skill_fit_score DESC;
why_it_fails: Matching vectors globally without partitioning by region produces candidates located 3,000 miles away.
